barbisteo.name: Barbisteo
barbisteo.description: As ravenous as the Infestation itself, this fish feeds on the remains of others. It shuns the light, preferring an enclosed cave environment.

boot.name: Boot
boot.description: Synthetic fibers and a molded foam insole were the basis for what was once a robust and comfortable combat boot. Now, it's a home for tiny aquatic organisms.

brickie.name: Brickie
brickie.description: Developed to perform remote construction and maintenance routines. It can be found in ponds around Venus.
